storyline.real: Schumacher wins his first Grand Prix: wets on lap 4, slicks on lap 30 after going off at Stavelot, 36.6 seconds ahead of the new champion Mansell
storyline.headline: Schumacher's first win, and Mansell off the podium

hidden.label: Win by more than Schumacher's real 36.6 seconds

eras.briefing: Spa, 1992. Rain arrived just before the start and everyone has stopped for wets. Now a dry line is appearing. Schumacher's Benetton started third. Pit board only: call the slicks. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
